description: Portal <-> Business Central bridges that are not BC data: the (unserved) Portal app_warehouse, whose code is the BC Location Code (its binding and the link to the generated BC locations are pending: ontology/schema/pending/bc_warehouse.json), and the BC number-series web-service actions as owner-system action types (a human runs them in BC after an MC approval; the Workbench never calls them).

object_types.description: A Portal warehouse (app_warehouse): a site whose code is the BC Location Code its stock posts to (warehouse-transfer-sync.ts resolveBcLocationCode: the upper-cased code unless BC_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_MAP remaps it). Not served by the reporting API: its binding and its link to the BC locations (Warehouse.bc_location) are declared in ontology/schema/pending/bc_warehouse.json, which replaces this placeholder when loaded with include_pending; Portal warehouse_id references reach it through the pending links.

availability.reason: public.app_warehouse is not an approved relation of the Portal reporting API (services/workbench-api/manifest/allowlist.json): no record of it is readable.

evidence.note: model Warehouse @@map("app_warehouse"): code unique, the Sage / ERP site code (11, 15, 34, virtual 22 / VMI).
resolveBcLocationCode: BC Location Code = trim(upper(Warehouse.code)), unless the BC_WAREHOUSE_LOCATION_MAP environment value remaps it.

action_types.description: Turn on Manual Nos. for one BC company's purchase order (or other) number series (BC web-service action PLXPurchaseOrderRef_EnsureOrderManualNos; the series is the requestJson seriesCode, empty: the Purchases & Payables Setup Order Nos.) so Portal-assigned numbers post. The Portal's own sync also calls it, automatically, on every runBcSync run (the bc-sync workflow every 5 minutes, the cron route, Sync now), with no human and no MC approval, fail-open: each call's error goes to the run's errors and the sync continues (plx-customer-portal@f3e3a5399d42 sync-runner.ts). It sets three series there: the Setup Order Nos. (sync-runner.ts:358-368); the customer series, BC_CUSTOMER_NO_SERIES (default C-CUST) and then the Sales & Receivables Setup Customer Nos. (customer-manual-nos.ts ensureCustomerManualNos, never an empty seriesCode), for the company (sync-runner.ts:234) and, once the Distribution book is hydrated, for the Distribution company (sync-runner.ts:272); and the sales order series, the second fail-open fallback beside PLXSalesBridge_EnsureSalesOrderManualNos: seriesCode BC_SALES_ORDER_NO_SERIES, default S-ORD (sync-runner.ts:394-405; the Distribution company at 454-465). This action type is the human correction in BC when a Portal number still fails to post. A write to BC Production: a human runs it in BC after an MC approval. The Workbench never calls it (its BC client is GET-only and its grammar names no ODataV4 action) and serves no No. Series record, so it never reads the effect back: verification person_check, the person who ran it confirms the series' Manual Nos. in BC.

ensureCustomerManualNos(companyName): the customer series before the customer POST; the catch records errors.customerManualNos and the sync continues (fail-open).

Once the Distribution book is hydrated, ensureCustomerManualNos(distName) (line 272): the Distribution company's customer series; the catch records errors.distCustomerManualNos and the sync continues (fail-open).

The second fail-open fallback for the sales series: PLXPurchaseOrderRef_EnsureOrderManualNos with requestJson {seriesCode: BC_SALES_ORDER_NO_SERIES, default "S-ORD"}; the catch records errors.soManualNosFallback and the sync continues.
The same S-ORD fallback for the Distribution company (PLXPurchaseOrderRef_EnsureOrderManualNos, distName); the catch records errors.distSoManualNosFallback and the sync continues (fail-open).

CUSTOMER_MANUAL_NOS_SERVICE = PLXPurchaseOrderRef_EnsureOrderManualNos, DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_NO_SERIES = C-CUST: ensureCustomerManualNos calls this action with seriesCode BC_CUSTOMER_NO_SERIES (default C-CUST), then the Sales & Receivables Setup Customer Nos., never an empty seriesCode (defaultEnsureSeries, ensureCustomerManualNos).
